_comment: Hook paths must be absolutised through $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR. With a relative path, any shell whose cwd is not the repository root (a worktree, a subagent scratch directory, a monorepo subfolder) fails to find the file, and the result is not a block but a non-blocking status code: the guard disappears silently and the command runs. An npm publish guard defeated that way removes the whole reason this repository has hooks. The `:-.` fallback exists so clients without the variable keep the previous behaviour; it is not the normal path.
